params.amountIn: amount of the start token to commit
params.deadline: unix timestamp after which the whole tx reverts, even if profitable
params.legs: ordered swap legs; legs[0]'s first hop's tokenIn must equal                    legs[last]'s last hop's tokenOut (the start token)
params.minProfit: minimum acceptable profit in start-token units (covers gas + margin)

executeTriangle((address,(address,addres.notice: Runs the leg chain and reverts unless profit clears minProfit.

isAllowedAdapter(address).notice: Adapters must be explicitly allowlisted before use. Closes off the risk of a scanner bug or compromised off-chain key pointing `leg.adapter` at an arbitrary attacker-supplied contract.

setAdapterAllowed(address,bool).notice: Allowlist (or de-allowlist) an adapter contract for use in leg execution.

sweep(address,uint256).notice: Sweep any token back to the owner (profit withdrawal or recovery).
